name: HVAC Refrigeration: Chillora
subtitle: HVAC Refrigeration Course
shortDescription: Adaptive HVAC and refrigeration course: fridge loop, coil, COP surface, duct and fan, room response in five 3D labs. Study aid only, not for real design.
longDescription:
HVAC Refrigeration: Chillora is a self-contained study app for a first course in heating, cooling and refrigeration. No sign-in, no account, works offline. It starts from machines you know: why the back of a refrigerator is warm, why an air handler drips water, why a heat pump struggles in the cold, why the far room gets weak air, how quickly a room warms up. It is for study only and is not for real system design, refrigerant handling or safety decisions.

### Five 3D Labs
- Fridge Loop: a vapour-compression loop with labelled evaporator, compressor, condenser and expansion valve, a live pressure-enthalpy chart and a first-law check.
- Coil and Air: a finned coil with copper tubes, air streaks coloured by temperature, condensate dripping into a drain pan, and a psychrometric chart.
- Heat-Pump Lift: a shaded COP surface over evaporating and condensing temperature with contour lines, a probe you can move and the Carnot limit as a translucent sheet.
- Duct and Fan: a duct run tinted by remaining pressure, a spinning fan, flow streaks, and the fan curve meeting the system curve.
- Room Response: a 3D room with heat gains and a cold supply plume, a time scrubber and the temperature history.
Every lab shows live formula chips and a short predict-then-test quiz, and opens its cited sources inside the app.

### Practice And Tests
Choose the length (5, 10, 20, 40 or your own number) and the level (beginner to research, or adaptive). 138 questions: numeric answers were checked against a second engine, conceptual ones are practice-only with a named source. The mock exam has no ads and an optional timer. 15 problem-first topic pages come with spaced review.

### Accessible, Free With Optional Ad Removal
Text size buttons on every screen and a calm-motion switch. Free with ads at natural breaks, never during a mock exam. An optional monthly subscription removes ads.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
